instruct: A young Welsh woman, low-pitched and quiet, unhurried and precise — a chronicler's careful diction, every word deliberately placed. A soft Welsh lilt with a faint constant musicality under the speech, as if she is almost singing without knowing it. Warm but measured; reading aloud to one person in a silent candlelit library.

text: Come in — I was just reading. Sit with me a moment, and I'll show you what the text actually says about her. It isn't what the song claims. It almost never is.
